headline: Karat Packaging Misses Q3 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
summary: Karat Packaging reported quarterly earnings that fell short of analyst estimates by $0.18 alongside weaker-than-expected revenue.
why: Earnings misses typically pressure a company's share price as investors reassess valuation and future profitability expectations.

impacts.name: Karat Packaging
impacts.why: Reported earnings and revenue below Wall Street expectations.
